fullDescription: A high-performance sports management and fintech design system featuring a sophisticated dark-mode palette, technical 'pitch' schematics, and status-driven UI. Defined by 'Pitch' navy (#0f172a) and 'Volt' green (#16a34a), it utilizes a high-contrast pairing of Archivo and DM Mono typography. Suitable for sports tech, dashboard-heavy SaaS, logistics tracking, and complex organizational tools. The layout focuses on data clarity, role-based perspective shifts, and smooth, scroll-triggered SVG animations.
prompt:
## Resumo
A technical, data-centric design system called 'PitchPeople' built for organizational clarity. It uses a professional navy and slate foundation with vivid status-based accents. Key features include animated pitch-inspired schematics, a 'lens' rotation visual for role switching, and a scroll-synced timeline. Typography balances bold athletic headings with monospace technical details.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using a dark-mode palette: primary bg #0f172a, secondary surface #090d16, borders #1e293b. Accent color is #16a34a (Ready Green). Typography: Archivo for all body and headers, DM Mono for all metadata, labels, and small technical tags. Headers should be font-weight: 900 with tight letter-spacing. UI elements must have 10px corner radius unless pill-shaped. Buttons: primary is white with #0f172a text, secondary is outlined with 2px #1e293b. Include status colors: #d97706 (waiting), #dc2626 (blocked), and #0284c7 (info), each with a corresponding 'soft' background (10-20% opacity) for status chips.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed top bar, height 80px (shrinks to 64px on scroll). Background: #090d16 with 95% opacity and backdrop-blur(12px). Border-bottom: 1px solid #1e293b. Right side: login link and a pill-shaped 'Register' CTA.

### Hero Section
Split 2-column layout. Background features subtle SVG pitch lines (center circle, goal boxes) in #1e293b that self-draw on load using stroke-dashoffset. Left column: Massive 900-weight typography with staggered reveal animations. Right column: A 'Role Lens' graphic—a central card (#0f172a) surrounded by an orbiting ring of rotating role labels (Player, Coach, etc.). Labels must counter-rotate to stay horizontal while the ring spins.

### How It Works Timeline
A progress-bar style horizontal timeline. Features a track in #e2e8f0 and a fill/token in #16a34a. The token (24px circle with 4px white border) should move its horizontal 'left' percentage based on the user's scroll position within the section. Below the track, use a 5-column grid with circular icons and status chips.

### Role Switcher Workspace
A two-column sticky layout. Left side: A vertical list of 'Role' cards. Active card has a 4px #16a34a left-border. Right side: A sticky mobile-device mockup (#090d16 frame). Inside the device, content cross-fades (opacity 0 to 1) between different data views based on which role is active or scrolled into view on the left.

### Matchday Pitch Visualization
A dark green or navy rectangle with white schematic lines representing a field. 4-3-3 formation represented by colored dots (28px circles). GK, DF, MF, FW labels in font-size 10px Archivo Bold. Include a 'Referee' dot in a contrasting yellow (#d97706). Items should 'pop' in with a scale(0.4 to 1) animation when section becomes visible.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Status Chip — A pill-shaped indicator used for state and tagging.
Height: 24px. Padding: 4px 10px. Border-radius: 999px. Background: Variable (e.g., #dcfce7 for success). Text: DM Mono, 11px, uppercase, letter-spacing: 0.06em. Includes a 7px circular dot (solid color) to the left of the text.

### Interactive Lens Ring — A complex orbital navigation or visual element.
Container: 420px square. Animation: 'spin' 20s linear infinite. Children: 'chips' positioned absolutely at 0, 90, 180, 270 degrees. Nested span inside chips: Animation: 'counterspin' 20s linear infinite (reverse of parent) to keep text legible.

## Notas Especiais
MUST use DM Mono for all text inside pill-shaped status chips. MUST ensure all primary buttons have a minimum height of 44px for accessibility. MUST use a 'reveal' class for scroll animations that translates 24px upwards while fading in. DO NOT use rounded corners larger than 16px for cards—keep them sharp and professional. DO NOT use pure black; always use #0f172a for the deepest backgrounds.

style.description: A modern 'Athletic-Industrial' aesthetic. Typography: Archivo (Sans, 400-900) for high-impact headings and readability; DM Mono (400-500) for technical 'eyebrows', status chips, and data points. Colors: Deep Navy (#0f172a), Rail Slate (#090d16), and Border Blue (#1e293b) form the core. Accent: Ready Green (#16a34a) for success/primary actions. Animations use cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.3, 1) for a snappy, fluid feel. Borders are thin (1px) with radii ranging from 6px (small) to 999px (pill).
